profile.headline: Information Technology Consultant / Developer at Audience Engagement Group
profile.summary: Highly motivated professional with Windows environments, experience on the AS/400, IBMi, Microsoft, Linux, AIX, environments. Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, protocols, SQL, XML, .NET, C#. Experience with internet, servers, desktops, laptops, mainframe technology, and engineering computer labs. IBM hardware testing SCSI, SAS, Flash, DASD, and SATA. A quick learner skilled in communication, problem solving, and research.
